title: Harbor and Promise
author: Odile Hartwell
blurb: Orsen Voss, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
